name: gap_continuation_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY gaps >0.7% at the open (driven by SGX Nifty futures or overnight US/global macro moves), and the gap holds un-filled during the first 30 minutes, institutional participants treat the sustained gap as a directional macro signal rather than noise. At 09:45, when the index then breaks above the first 30-min range high (gap-up case) or below the first 30-min range low (gap-down case), VWAP-benchmarked algorithms receive a confirmed reference level and begin working large directional orders simultaneously. This coordinated institutional flow creates a 30-90 second momentum burst on NIFTY as multiple systematic strategies trigger on the same breakout event.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap > 0.7% that remains unfilled after 30 minutes then breaks above/below the first 30-min range with volume > 1.2x average
